001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.fleets;
002
003import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetMemberAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Conditions;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Factions;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.FleetTypes;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Industries;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.People;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd.SDResolution;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.FleetCreatorMission;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetQuality;
019import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.FleetSize;
020import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerNum;
021import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.HubMissionWithTriggers.OfficerQuality;
022import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.missions.hub.MissionFleetAutoDespawn;
023import com.fs.starfarer.api.loading.VariantSource;
024
025public class PersonalFleetHoracioCaden extends PersonalFleetScript {
026        
027        public PersonalFleetHoracioCaden() {
028                super(People.CADEN);
029                setMinRespawnDelayDays(10f);
030                setMaxRespawnDelayDays(20f);
031        }
032        
033        @Override
034        protected MarketAPI getSourceMarket() {
035                return Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
036        }
037
038        @Override
039        public CampaignFleetAPI spawnFleet() {
040                
041                MarketAPI sindria = getSourceMarket();
042                
043                FleetCreatorMission m = new FleetCreatorMission(random);
044                m.beginFleet();
045                
046                Vector2f loc = sindria.getLocationInHyperspace();
047                
048                m.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.HUGE, FleetQuality.VERY_HIGH, Factions.LIONS_GUARD, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, loc);
049                m.triggerSetFleetOfficers( OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.DEFAULT);
050                m.triggerSetFleetCommander(getPerson());
051                m.triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
052                m.triggerSetPatrol();
053                m.triggerSetFleetMemoryValue(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SOURCE_MARKET, sindria);
054                m.triggerFleetSetNoFactionInName();
055                m.triggerFleetSetName("Lion's Guard Grand Armada");
056                m.triggerPatrolAllowTransponderOff();
057                m.triggerFleetSetPatrolActionText("parading");
058                m.triggerOrderFleetPatrol(sindria.getStarSystem());
059                
060                CampaignFleetAPI fleet = m.createFleet();
061                fleet.removeScriptsOfClass(MissionFleetAutoDespawn.class);
062                sindria.getContainingLocation().addEntity(fleet);
063                fleet.setLocation(sindria.getPlanetEntity().getLocation().x, sindria.getPlanetEntity().getLocation().y);
064                fleet.setFacing((float) random.nextFloat() * 360f);
065                
066                // for the Lion's Guard only; make the Executor use the default with-special-weapons variant
067                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
068                        if (member.isCapital()) {
069                                member.setVariant(member.getVariant().clone(), false, false);
070                                member.getVariant().setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
071                                member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.TAG_NO_AUTOFIT);
072                                member.getVariant().addTag(Tags.VARIANT_CONSISTENT_WEAPON_DROPS);
073                        }
074                }
075                
076                return fleet;
077        }
078
079        @Override
080        public boolean canSpawnFleetNow() {
081                MarketAPI sindria = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket("sindria");
082                if (sindria == null || sindria.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) return false;
083                if (!sindria.hasIndustry(Industries.LIONS_GUARD)) return false;
084                if (!sindria.getFactionId().equals(Factions.DIKTAT)) return false;
085                if (SDResolution.get() != null) return SDResolution.get().allowPersonalFleetRewpawns();
086                if (SDResolution.isAskoniaStandoffCompleted()) {
087                        return false;
088                }
089                return true;
090        }
091
092        @Override
093        public boolean shouldScriptBeRemoved() {
094                return false;
095        }
096
097}
